criteria.name: compact_numeric_answer
criteria.description: Returns all nine requested numeric fields and the sequence class in compact JSON.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit when the class is present but one or two numeric fields are missing or mislabeled.

criteria.name: event_pair_and_rank
criteria.description: Uses the M7.8 April 25 mainshock, the M7.3 May 12 Nepal earthquake, the 17.04-day interval, and rank 2.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for identifying the correct pair but missing either the elapsed time or rank.

criteria.name: moment_math
criteria.description: Computes the 0.5 magnitude deficit, 0.178 May12/mainshock moment share, and 5.62 inverse ratio.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for a correct formula with a rounding or reciprocal error.

criteria.name: catalog_counts
criteria.description: Counts five Nepal earthquakes at M>=6.0 and computes a red-alert share of 0.571.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for one correct count or for a small denominator error.

criteria.name: precip_threshold_ledger
criteria.description: Finds the maximum precipitation mean of 13.14 mm and zero means at or above 20 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for the correct maximum or threshold count alone.

criteria.name: rounding_and_scope
criteria.description: Applies the requested rounding using only the requested computed fields.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial credit for minor formatting issues with otherwise correct numeric work.
